about: Essex is a town in Essex County, Ontario, inland from Windsor and Lake Erie in Canada’s far southwest. It combines a small urban centre with surrounding farmland in one of the country’s warmest growing regions. Highways 3 and county roads link toward Windsor, Harrow, and the lake shore. About 21,000 people live in the Town of Essex.
